scope: su/main/synthetics_waveforms_testpatterns part 1 of 2 — incomplete: only four programs are inventoried below. The remaining ten need source and library-call verification before this inventory can be used to generate builder jobs.

programs.name: suaddevent
programs.purpose: Add a linear or hyperbolic event to each input trace.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUADDEVENT - add a linear or hyperbolic moveout event to seismic data

params.name: dt
params.default: computed: first trace header dt in microseconds divided by 1000000
params.description: Required when the first trace header dt is zero.

params.name: type
params.description: Use lmo for linear moveout; other values select hyperbolic moveout.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: Sinc interpolation and sqrt affect results. The times array is constructed before a missing header dt is replaced by the dt parameter, so that fallback leaves all interpolation times equal to tmin.
programs.difficulty_reason: The program uses sinc interpolation and trace header coordinates to place events.

test_cases.command: sunull nt=128 ntr=8 dt=0.004 | sushw key=offset a=0 b=100 | suaddevent type=nmo t0=0.1 vel=2000 amp=2

test_cases.description: Linear event with negative and positive offsets.
test_cases.command: sunull nt=128 ntr=8 dt=0.004 | sushw key=offset a=-300 b=100 | suaddevent type=lmo t0=0.05 vel=1500 amp=-1

programs.name: sudgwaveform
programs.purpose: Generate a Gaussian derivative waveform as one SU trace.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUDGWAVEFORM - make Gaussian derivative waveform in SU format

params.name: n
params.description: Derivative order; must be at least one.

params.name: nfpeak
params.description: Multiplier of peak frequency used to determine the sample interval.

params.name: nt
params.description: Number of waveform samples; the code differs from the selfdoc's stated default of 128.

programs.float_sensitive_notes: The waveform is computed in double precision and cast to float; sqrt and the Gaussian derivative implementation can vary across math libraries.
programs.difficulty_reason: The waveform depends on the library implementation of arbitrary-order Gaussian derivatives.

test_cases.description: Second derivative with explicit sampling controls.
test_cases.command: sudgwaveform n=2 fpeak=35 nfpeak=4 nt=128 sign=1 shift=0

test_cases.description: Higher derivative with reversed polarity and shift.
test_cases.command: sudgwaveform n=4 fpeak=30 nfpeak=8 nt=128 sign=-1 shift=0.01

programs.license_note: The header states that parts outside the original CWP/SU code are copyright 2007 Society of Exploration Geophysicists and refers to SEG usage terms.

programs.name: suimpedance
programs.purpose: Convert reflectivity traces to impedance traces using a sample-by-sample recursion.
programs.selfdoc_first_line: SUIMPEDANCE - Convert reflection coefficients to impedances.
programs.float_sensitive_notes: The initial v0*rho0 multiplication uses float operands; the recursive impedance is double and each output sample is cast to float. Reflectivities are clamped to ±0.9999.
programs.difficulty_reason: Each trace is processed by a simple sequential recursion.

test_cases.command: sunull nt=64 ntr=2 dt=0.004 | suimpedance v0=1500 rho0=1000

test_cases.description: Impulse reflectivity changes the impedance after the impulse.
test_cases.command: suspike nt=64 ntr=2 dt=0.004 k1=10 mag=0.5 | suimpedance v0=2000 rho0=1200

programs.name: sunull
programs.float_sensitive_notes: The sample interval is converted to integer microseconds using NINT.
programs.difficulty_reason: The program fills zero traces and sets a few header fields.

test_cases.description: Single trace with a different sample interval.
